title: Log rows show the user, and date and time in your location's calendar
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Note your user name.
  • Make sure you are also enrolled at location B, in a time zone a whole number of hours apart from the test location, and note that difference in hours.
  • Make sure Net 50 is active.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 50" row.
  2. Click "Deactivate".
  3. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  4. Click "Audit Log".
  5. Close the log.
  6. Switch location to location B.
  7. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  8. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A green success toast shows.

Step 3:

  • The menu opens.

Step 4:

  • The newest row shows your user name under User.
  • It shows the date and time of the change as clocks at the test location read them.

Step 5:

  • The log closes.

Step 6:

  • The page reloads.

Step 7:

  • The menu opens.

Step 8:

  • The same row now shows the time later by the difference in hours (as clocks at location B read it).
  • The date changes too if the move crosses midnight.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-R4: “The User column shows the name of the user who made the change; Date and Time show when, on the calendar of the location the user is working in.”
  • S12-R6: “The log is organization-wide (one log for all locations), kept indefinitely, and cannot be edited or deleted by anyone.”
